## What we do

We manufacture pet care products (deodorizing, grooming, outdoor protection, pet nutrition) for global brands on **OEM** (your formula), **ODM** (our 20 ready SKUs + your label), and **OBM** (turnkey) cooperation models.

We do NOT sell direct-to-consumer. We are a B2B contract manufacturer.

## Product lines (4 lines, 20 catalogue SKUs)

All 20 catalogue SKUs sit on 3 of these lines.
The Pet Nutrition line carries no catalogue SKU code and is quoted project by project.
Every SKU is available private label: minimum order and lead time are stated here, prices are quoted on request.

## Pricing (B2B wholesale, custom-quoted)

We do not publish unit prices. Every order is custom-quoted based on SKU, batch volume, customization, packaging, Incoterms, and destination.

Submit the enquiry form at <https://shenhezhongke.com/contact.html> or message via WhatsApp. A named sales manager replies within one business day with a tailored quote (USD/EUR/RMB).

## Private label vs custom formulation (9 dimensions)

| Dimension | Custom formulation (OEM) | Private label |
|---|---|---|
| Formula | Customer provides | Factory provides ready formulas |
| Best for | Brands with R&D | Startups, fast launch |
| Lead time | 30–45 days (custom formulation, formula and sample) | 25–40 days (private label, after the sample is approved) |
| MOQ | 1,000–3,000 units | 1,000 sets on the bundled sets, 2,000 bottles on catalogue SKUs |
| IP | Customer owns | Factory owns |
| Cost | Higher setup, lower unit | Lower setup, mid unit |
| Customization | Full formula | Label / packaging |
| Samples | Chargeable, 7–10 days of bench work | Chargeable, 5–7 days for an existing SKU |
| Compliance | Customer-led | Factory-led (FDA, ISO, MSDS) |

## 6-step process

Enquiry → Sample → Quote (1 business day) → Contract (NDA) → Production (batch production, on-site QC sampling) → Shipment (export packing and dispatch)

## Payment terms

- 35% T/T deposit + 65% balance before shipment (standard orders)
- L/C at sight (large orders, threshold by negotiation)
- USD / EUR / RMB accepted (USD is default invoice currency)

## Currency and FX policy


- Buyer can request EUR or RMB invoice at quote time
- FX rate locked at invoice date (large orders); the rate applied is the one stated on the Proforma Invoice
- FX rate fixed at deposit-receipt date (standard orders)
- Buyer bears FX risk from invoice date to deposit receipt; supplier bears risk thereafter

## Pricing basis (VAT / Tax / Duty)

- All prices are **EX-Works VAT-exclusive, GST-exclusive, and import-duty-exclusive**
- Buyer (importer of record) pays all destination-country taxes
- EU buyers with VAT registration: self-account via reverse-charge mechanism (EU VAT Directive Article 196)
- We provide commercial invoice with HS code + country of origin for your customs declaration
- Other documents per shipment: packing list, certificate of origin (CCPIT), fumigation certificate (if ISPM-15 pallet)

## Incoterms® 2020

- **Default:** FOB Guangzhou / Shenzhen (per ICC Publication 723E)
- Available on request: EXW, FCA, CIF, CFR, DAP, DDP, DPU
- Risk transfers at named port of loading
- Each quote specifies which term applies

## HS codes (major categories)

- Pet deodorizing sprays / disinfectants: HS 3307 / 3808
- Pet shampamp / cleaning foam: HS 3305 / 3401
- Pet paw care / moisturizing: HS 3304 / 3307
- Outdoor insect repellent spray: HS 3808
- Pet probiotics / nutrition supplements: HS 2309 / 2106
- Laundry detergent: HS 3402
- Tooth cleaner / oral care: HS 3306
- Ear cleaning: HS 3307
- Full HS code provided on commercial invoice for every shipment

## Quality guarantee and acceptance

- 6-step in-house QC (IQC → batching → IPQC → filling → OQC → 3rd-party verification)
- COA per batch attached to shipment; MSDS for all 20 SKUs
- **7-day acceptance window** from arrival at destination for visible / packaging defects
- **30-day window** for active-ingredient / efficacy claims
- Discrepancies filed with photo evidence + lab report within window
- Verified defects replaced at supplier cost
- Returns via FOB Guangzhou back-haul

## Cancellation and refund policy

- **35% T/T deposit non-refundable** after artwork approval
- Balance 100% refundable if production not started (typically 7 days post-deposit)
- Custom-formula R&D costs non-refundable once lab work begins
- Sample policy: existing SKU samples available; custom-formula samples require lab-work deposit (quote on request)

## Product liability insurance

- Coverage: USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 5,000,000 aggregate
- Underwriter: PICC Property and Casualty Company Limited
- Worldwide coverage (USA / Canada / EU primary)
- Certificate copy available on request
- Buyer can be added as additional insured for large orders (one-time admin fee applies)

## Regulatory compliance

- **China:** GB National Standard, CSAR where applicable
- **USA:** FDA facility registered (registration number on file); 21 CFR compliance; Prop 65 statement on request
- **EU:** Regulation (EC) 1223/2009 (Cosmetics); REACH SVHC declarations on request; CLP / SDS per Annex II; CPSR for applicable SKUs (lead time 14-21 days, fee USD 500-1500); BPR 528/2012 for disinfectant SKUs
- **UK:** UKCA marking where applicable (post-Brexit)
- **Other:** Canada (Health Canada NNHPD), Australia (TGA exemption for pet care cosmetics), Japan (quasi-drug registration where applicable)
- **Documentation:** MSDS (16-language), CPSR, INCI ingredient disclosure, allergen declaration, animal-testing statement (Cruelty-Free, Leaping Bunny pending 2027), Certificate of Free Sale

## Dispute resolution and governing law

- Contracts governed by **the laws of the People's Republic of China**
- Default arbitration: **CIETAC** (China International Economic and Trade Arbitration Commission), Shanghai, English-language, 3 arbitrators
- Alternative for large orders: ICC (Paris) or HKIAC (Hong Kong)
- Awards enforceable in 170+ jurisdictions under New York Convention 1958
- Pre-arbitration: 30-day good-faith negotiation → CCPIT mediation → arbitration

## ESG and sustainability

- ISO 22716 (Cosmetic GMP) certified
- Cruelty-free formulations since 2020 (no animal testing on finished products or ingredients)
- Plant-based ingredients in 11 of 20 SKUs
- Class-D cleanroom wastewater treated on-site per GB 8978-1996
- ISO 14001 (Environmental) target Q2 2027; ISO 45001 (Occupational Health) target Q4 2026
- Solar panel installation (1.2 MW, ~30% facility demand) target Q4 2026
- PCR (Post-Consumer Recycled) plastic packaging option available at +5% unit cost

## Third-party lab reports (10 PDFs, available for download)

Each report number below is the one printed on the document, so it can be
quoted back. The SHA-256 is the fingerprint of the exact file served here.
The finding is what the report measured, and the page is that report
written out as text — the numbers inside a PDF cannot be read by a crawler.

## Batch attestations (0 attested, 0 written to the chain)

Every production batch carries the SHA-256 of its laboratory report, written to
a public blockchain, so the report in a buyer's hands can be compared with the
one that was filed. The transaction is on a public chain and is not ours to edit.

- the index of attested batches: https://shenhezhongke.com/attestation.html
- the SHA-256 of every published report: https://shenhezhongke.com/report-hashes.json

An attestation proves that the report file existed at the recorded time and has
not been changed since. It does not prove that the product is approved for any
market, and it does not prove that the product is good.

MSDS available for all 20 SKUs. Pet Deodorizing Spray 350 mL MSDS published in English.

## Patents, standards and trademarks (what this company holds)

- **Granted utility model patent** — Space spray deodorizing device (空间喷雾除臭设备), application CN202422485591.8, granted 2025-09-09 as CN223311460U, in force to 2034-10-14. Held jointly by Guangdong Shenhe Zhongke Biotechnology Co., Ltd. and Shenzhen Yongsheng Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd. IPC A61L9/14. **This is a device patent — it covers how the deodorizing liquid is delivered across a space. It is not a patent on a pet care formula, and we claim none.**
- **Our own enterprise standard** — Q/SHZK 12-2026《宠物洁齿水》, published 2026-05-23, in force. Drafted by us. A standard we wrote and published, not a certificate another body issued to us.
- **Registered trademark** — 贝洛宠, registration 89702457, class 3, registered 2026-08-13, in force to 2036-08-13. Held by 广东深河中科生物科技有限公司. Check by registration number or by applicant name in the trademark comprehensive query at sbj.cnipa.gov.cn. We file other marks under the same company name as well; those are checked by applicant name, because a trademark status changes and a number printed here can be wrong by the time a buyer reads it.

A formula developed for a customer stays the customer's property, and the NDA comes before the discussion. The laboratory reports published on this site were made on samples belonging to customers, on their own brands — the sample name is on the report, and we do not claim the brand.

Page: https://shenhezhongke.com/intellectual-property.html

## Factory & R&D

- 30,000m² self-owned industrial park in Heyuan, Guangdong
- 5,000m² GMP workshop, class-D cleanroom filling, 1,000,000 bottles / month
- 3,000m² office building, 220+ employees
- In-house technical team develops all 20 SKUs; active R&D cooperation with partner universities
- All product lines mature and commercially proven
- Patents registered and verifiable: bio-enzyme + probiotic complex, stabilized chlorine dioxide system, plant-based insect repellent blend, trigger-lock spray gun design & utility models
- 6-step QC process: IQC → batching → IPQC → filling → OQC → 3rd-party claim verification
- Independent third-party lab reports for every published claim (kill rate, ammonia removal, etc.)

### Third-party laboratory reports
- [2024FM11610R01D — Disinfectant &amp; deodorizing liquid — analysis](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/2024fm11610r01d.html) — Kill rates above 99.9999% in the suspension bactericidal and fungicidal tests.
- [2024FM11611R02D — Pet deodorant — safety assessment](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/2024fm11611r02d.html) — Acute oral toxicity LD50 above 5000 mg/kg; no skin or eye irritation in rabbits.
- [2024FM11612R01D — Multi-effect wash — antibacterial](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/2024fm11612r01d.html) — Inhibition rate above 99.97% under GB/T 27404.1.11.3.2.
- [2024FM11612R02D — Multi-effect wash — microbiological and](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/2024fm11612r02d.html) — Aerobic bacterial count below 10 CFU/g, thermotolerant coliforms absent; meets QB/T 4524-2013.
- [2024FM11612R03D — Multi-effect wash — mite control](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/2024fm11612r03d.html) — Mite control: 100% kill rate at 48 hours against Dermatophagoides farinae.
- [2024FM12662R01Da — Purepaws neutralising spray — full analysis](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/2024fm12662r01da.html) — Kill rates above 99.999% against Trichophyton mentagrophytes and Microsporum canis.
- [NACCYH25007027 — Cat litter deodorizer — ammonia removal](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/naccyh25007027.html) — Ammonia 1.53 → 0.052 mg/m³, a 96.6% removal, on the cat litter deodorizer.
- [NACCYH25014721 — Pet deodorant — hydrogen sulfide removal](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/naccyh25014721.html) — Hydrogen sulfide 0.15 → <0.010 mg/m³, a 93.3% removal, on the same sample.
- [NACCYH25014722 — Pet deodorant — ammonia removal](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/naccyh25014722.html) — Ammonia 1.53 → 0.088 mg/m³, a 94.2% removal, on the pet deodorant sample.
- [XJ2025001233 — Disinfectant — available chlorine stability](https://shenhezhongke.com/reports/xj2025001233.html) — Available chlorine 130 mg/L, and 111 mg/L after 14 days at 54 °C — a 14.6% fall.
